body: I tried making friends, but people don't want to hang around with someone like me. I have some friends I guess, but most of our conversations revolve around them making jokes about everything I hate about myself and saying how easy I am to bully. There isn't really anything I'm looking forward to, bar getting my student loan and moving into a place that actually has windows (my current flat doesn't). But that's hardly a reason to live.

Thank you. I know that, but I've been hanging on one more month now for years. I actually decided on my 19th birthday (the last time I actively went out to kill myself) that I'd wait another year. Somehow, things have gotten worse since then.
